scope: MVP news V2 interface and legacy news-reader navigation
News service V2 providers, worker, settings and storage

evidencePolicy.notes: This register records review observations; it is not a new live source crawl, entitlement check, or proof that corrections were implemented. A production reader check executed the actual transpiled route with production configuration and stubbed database access; it did not deploy the application.
evidencePolicy.appliesTo: Original independent review at the reviewed commits; later code fixes and live free-source sync are recorded separately.

findings.title: Concurrent partial settings updates restore revoked access
findings.method: Deterministic concurrent-read fixture with serialized write transactions inside a rollback-only PostgreSQL transaction.
reproduction: Begin with a configured provider enabled and licensed for full text.
Synchronize initial reads of two partial requests: revoke enabled/displayLicensed; change only fullTextEnabled to false.
Allow writes in that order and read the resulting configuration.
findings.requiredCorrection: Read, merge and validate current configuration after acquiring the provider lock inside its transaction.
findings.acceptance: An unrelated partial settings update must not undo concurrent revocation in either request order.

findings.title: Paginated snapshots retain or restore disabled-source stories
findings.method: Two isolated browser fixtures; every API request intercepted.
reproduction: Delay a Load older stories response, disable its provider, receive an empty fresh feed, then deliver the delayed response.
Separately load two pages, simulate disabling the provider elsewhere, and advance the browser clock six minutes.

observed.exposureProven: Headlines and summaries; no full-text reader authorization bypass established.

findings.requiredCorrection: Invalidate old requests and saved pages on source/access changes and keep paginated-view freshness checks active.
findings.acceptance: Neither delayed responses nor another tab's revocation may retain or restore disabled-source cards.

resolution.change: Invalidate stale pagination generations on access/settings changes, revalidate loaded pages every minute, and filter against current provider access.

findings.title: Finnhub continuation exceeds worker checkpoint limit
findings.method: Mocked Finnhub HTTP response; returned cursor compared with the actual worker pre-persistence validation.
reproduction: Return 220 valid synthetic articles, each with a 700-character summary.
Call the adapter with the worker's limit=50 and inspect returned continuation.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use bounded continuation and durable storage for pending records or an equivalent bounded progress mechanism.
findings.acceptance: Ingest every fixture record within bounded jobs, including a restart between batches, without oversized checkpoints.

findings.title: Stale updates resurrect withdrawn articles
findings.method: Rollback-only PostgreSQL fixture using the adapter's undated deletion shape.
reproduction: Persist an article updated at 10:05.
Confirm a stale update from 10:01 is rejected.
Persist deletion without updatedAt, then replay that stale update.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve source ordering and withdrawal precedence; define explicit source-confirmed restoration semantics.
findings.acceptance: Stale replay after an undated removal must leave the item withdrawn, including after restart.

findings.title: Legacy internal reader denies all namespaces in production
findings.method: Execute actual transpiled route and guard with NODE_ENV=production; database access stubbed to throw if reached.
reproduction: Use each legacy reader namespace with production configuration.
Observe the guard response before any database or service request.
findings.requiredCorrection: Scope preview restrictions appropriately or retain working publisher navigation when the reader is unavailable, preserving required access protection.
findings.acceptance: Verify all legacy entry points in a production build and without V2 setup under the intended access model.

findings.title: Unchanged article replays do not repair catalogue associations
reproduction: Ingest an unmatched article with sufficient identity evidence.
Insert its exact matching company in the catalogue and verify resolution now succeeds.
Replay the unchanged article and count its associations.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reconcile associations separately from content changes or on catalogue/mapping version changes.
findings.acceptance: Gain the correct association after a catalogue repair without changing article text or generating a spurious text revision.

findings.title: Temporary SEC body failure overwrites previously retrieved text
findings.method: Mocked successful submissions/body response followed by unchanged submissions and a document HTTP 503; inspected store replacement semantics.
reproduction: Retrieve a supported filing and its text successfully.
Return the same filing metadata but HTTP 503 for its document on the next poll.

observed.storeBehavior: The upsert replaces existing body and rights with the new record.

findings.requiredCorrection: Distinguish temporary retrieval failure from explicit withdrawal or rights change, preserve prior permitted text, and retry retrieval.
findings.acceptance: Text survives HTTP 503 and a later genuine source update is accepted.

resolution.change: Transient SEC document retrieval failures emit no replacement article, preserving stored body text. The next bounded snapshot can retry; auth errors propagate to paused worker handling.

findings.title: Marketaux effective page-size change skips articles
findings.method: Mocked fixed-window pagination with a simulated same-key plan upgrade.
reproduction: Keep a fixed 50-article window and request limit=40.
Return page one with effective limit=3 and IDs1–3.
Resume the saved page cursor with effective limit=40 and IDs41–50.
findings.requiredCorrection: Persist effective page size or detect changes and safely replay the window with deduplication.
findings.acceptance: Page-size changes in either direction retain all50 fixture records before advancing the stable watermark.

findings.title: Later V1 Marketaux page failure discards earlier successful results
findings.method: Synthetic configuration and mocked HTTP; no database connection or provider calls.
reproduction: Return three valid articles on page one.
Return HTTP429 on page two.
findings.requiredCorrection: Return and persist validated partial articles, keep the window incomplete and watermark unchanged, and expose the failure reason.
findings.acceptance: The three validated articles survive the failure and later ingestion completes without gaps or duplicates.

separateKnownLimitations: SEC live access returned HTTP403 in this environment.
No live paid-feed credentials or contractual entitlement tests.
V2 intentionally operates as a single local development workspace.
Finnhub ticker-only query provenance needs verified listing mappings before portfolio association.

excludedObservation.title: Historical revision bodies after article-level bodyAllowed changes
excludedObservation.reason: Not counted among the nine findings: adapters also use bodyAllowed=false for unavailable text; article-specific revocation/retention semantics need clarification.

apiFields.previewText: Optional null/string, literal excerpt from permitted body or original summary, max 700 characters.
apiFields.readingMinutes: Optional null/number, full permitted body word count at 200 words per minute.
